config._desc_data_retrieval: Settings for fetching bigquery and generating inline RCA prior to formatting

data_retrieval._desc_num_slowest_queries: Retrieves enough data for distributions, but keeps SQL fast. Keep low since full table fetch is expensive.
data_retrieval._desc_num_error_queries: Keep high (e.g. 50k) to still catch the macro error distribution / stats for the summary at the top.
data_retrieval._desc_num_queries_to_analyze_rca: Only generate LLM RCA for what you actually display! Matches data_presentation limits to avoid wasted wait time and API costs.

config._desc_data_presentation: Settings limiting the actual rows rendered in the final markdown report

data_presentation._desc_num_error_queries: Displays the top 5 error queries in the markdown tables to keep report readable.
data_presentation._desc_num_slowest_queries: Displays the top 5 slowest queries in the markdown tables.

queries: Some additional instructions to add to the prompt.
